Question: I am bit confused in this matter. i came to know from so many muslims brothers that we should not say yazid raziallah hoo tala umhoo.please let me know he is sahabi or not? Answer ID: 3537 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 273/274=L) Yazeed is not a sahabi (companion of the Prophet صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ): یزید بن معاویۃ بن ابی سفیان ولد فی خلافۃ عثمان ( تھذیب التھذیب: 11/314 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
